hero.title: Build your financial empire in TradeVerse
hero.subtitle: Trade stocks and crypto, buy real estate, run companies, mine coins and climb the leaderboard. A virtual economy with real market mechanics — free to play.

features.title: One world, dozens of ways to earn
features.subtitle: TradeVerse blends trading, investing and business strategy into a single virtual economy.

stocks.title: Stock trading
stocks.desc: Buy and sell company shares at live prices, track charts, dividends and market events.

crypto.title: Cryptocurrency
crypto.desc: Trade crypto coins on a volatile market, transfer assets to other players and time your entries and exits.

realestate.title: Real estate
realestate.desc: Buy apartments and houses, upgrade them, rent them out to other players and earn passive income.

companies.title: Companies & business
companies.desc: Found your own company, hire employees, pay salaries and grow a profitable enterprise.

mining.title: Mining farms
mining.desc: Assemble farms from GPUs and CPUs, overclock your rigs and mine crypto around the clock.

leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
leaderboard.desc: Compete with players by net worth and income, climb the rankings and prove you're the best trader.

cityroof.title: City rooftop
cityroof.desc: Capture businesses, protect your assets and fight for influence over the city each season.

bank.title: Bank & transfers
bank.desc: Manage your account, send money by card number or username and analyse your financial history.

how.title: Start earning in three steps
how.subtitle: No deposits required — just strategy, calculation and a bit of risk.

step1.title: Create an account
step1.desc: Sign up in a minute and get starting capital for your first trades. Free and no bank card needed.

step2.title: Choose your path
step2.desc: Trade on the exchange, mine crypto, buy real estate or build a business empire — mix the mechanics as you like.

step3.title: Grow your capital
step3.desc: Reinvest your profit, outpace rivals in the rankings and become the richest player in TradeVerse.

finalCta.title: Ready to test yourself against the market?
finalCta.subtitle: Join TradeVerse and start building your financial empire today.

footer.tagline: A virtual economy game: trading, business and strategy.
footer.disclaimer: In-game currency has no real-world value. TradeVerse is an entertainment simulator.

gift.desc: The asset moves to another player in full, with all upgrades. Its income will go to the new owner. This is irreversible.

media.onboardDesc: Buy the "Media Holding" business in the shop to order exposes against rival companies.

media.warn: Higher budget means higher chance. On failure the budget burns and the target income temporarily rises by {{backfire}}%.
media.resultSuccess: Expose succeeded! Target income reduced for {{hours}}h.
media.resultFail: Expose failed - budget burned, interest in the target rose for {{hours}}h.
media.resultPending: Expose ordered - the story will run in ~{{minutes}} min.
